project: Real Mall of America asset pack
scope: Separated exports of the supplied generated artwork, traced identity, original functional icons and motion from stills. Not a deployed Shopify theme.
notes: No artificial enlargement is described as new photographic detail.
Small category crops have native masters and explicit resampled variants.
Reference concepts contain unverified promotional claims and are not production assets.
Videos are camera/light animation from stills, not filmed or independently generated scenes.
